# Security Policy — GLASTOR® Specter

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in `@glastor-core/specter`, please report it responsibly to **Andrés Antonio Cardoso — GLASTOR® Core** at **<ventas@glastor.es>** or via [https://glastor.es](https://glastor.es).

- **Response SLA**: Within 24 hours.
- Please do **not** open public GitHub issues for undisclosed vulnerabilities.
